subject: Recap + ask: scope-to-spend onramp validation (pilot pricing & PO threshold)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: scope-to-spend onramp validation (pilot pricing & PO threshold)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can get a pilot order in front of your procurement team next week.

Recap (from our conversation):
- Primary use: customer-facing assistant (search + summarization + routing).
- Expected sustained usage after pilot: roughly 15–30M tokens / month (peaks hit ~50M with marketing spikes).
- Latency target: 300–500ms p95 for user-facing flows.
- Data requirements: VPC/private routing for logs; FOIA-like export not required.

Cost & budget validation (we discussed ranges on the call):
- You mentioned short-term pilot budget somewhere in the $20k–$40k / month corridor.
- Finance procurement rule: PO required above a monthly invoice threshold (please confirm exact $ figure).

Proposed pilot commercial we can prepare immediately:
- 3-month pilot, capped at 50M tokens / month, billed monthly.
- Pilot list price: $35 per 1M tokens for the first 30M tokens, then a tiered step-down to $28 per 1M beyond that (example blended ~$32/1M if usage sits at ~30M).
- If procurement requires a single PO, we can structure a 3-month aggregate PO and monthly invoices against it.

Asks:
1) Please confirm the procurement PO threshold (is it $25k/month or $30k/month?).
2) Can you confirm the expected monthly token band for the pilot (low / likely / high) so I can finalize the spend model?

Attachments: I attached a short spend model (CloudForge_Spend_Model.xlsx) and a copy of your procurement questionnaire if you sent it earlier — would appreciate the completed form or any special billing instructions.

If we can get answers to those two asks by EOD Mon 9/6, I’ll send an initial Order Form + DocuSign link and loop in Legal for a quick one-page addendum.

Best,

Subject: Re: Recap + ask: scope-to-spend onramp validation (pilot pricing & PO threshold)

Hi Hannah — appreciate the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement threshold: Finance requires a PO for any recurring spend > $30,000 / month. Anything below that can be handled via monthly invoices and Net30.
2) Pilot expected band: low ~12M tokens/mo, likely ~25M tokens/mo, high ~45M tokens/mo (mainly during promotional weeks).
3) We’ll need an explicit cap option on any pilot to avoid runaway spend; the cap you suggested (50M) looks fine as long as we have alerting at 70% and 90% of cap.

On pricing: your $35/1M for first 30M looks promising — two internal asks: can you show the blended effective $/1M for the likely scenario (25M) and a worst-case for 45M? That helps our finance modelers.

Also attaching our standard procurement form for you/Legal to glance at.

Samir Patel

Hannah / Markus — quick ops note after looking at Samir’s numbers and their procurement form:

- Recommended pilot commercial (sales ops POV):
  * 3-month pilot (RDW-7842) with a single PO option (CloudForge can issue a 3-month PO that we invoice monthly).
  * Billing: monthly invoices, Net30, with PO reference on each invoice.
  * Pricing structure we should propose to be conservative but competitive: $40 / 1M tokens flat for pilot up to 30M (no tier), then $30 / 1M beyond 30M for overage. Rationale: simplifies finance review and avoids complex blended math in their procurement form.
- Alerting/caps: Add automated alerts at 70% and 90% of the PO cap (we can turn on token usage webhooks).
- PO threshold alignment: since finance requires PO > $30k/month, propose offering the single PO for the 3-month total (e.g., if expected monthly is $25k, 3-month PO ~$75k). This keeps procurement happy and keeps billing simple.

If sales prefers to keep the $35/$28 tiered structure from initial ask, we’ll need a short note explaining blended impact for 25M and 45M scenarios (I can compute). Otherwise ops prefers the $40 flat/then $30 overage for clarity.

Happy to run the blended numbers and an invoice example for Samir.

—Monica

Samir — thanks for the quick return and the procurement form. Based on Ops input (see Monica’s note below) and to keep procurement review straightforward, here’s what we propose for the pilot order:

Proposed pilot commercial (final for sign-off):
- Term: 3 months (pilot)
- Cap: 50M tokens / month (alerts at 35M and 45M)
- Pricing: $40 / 1M tokens flat for the first 30M per month; $30 / 1M tokens for any usage beyond 30M in the same month.
- Billing: Redwood will accept a single 3-month PO from CloudForge and invoice monthly (Net30) with PO reference on each invoice.
- Procurement threshold: we understand CloudForge requires PO for > $30k/month — this structure is compatible (we'll accept the PO and invoice monthly).

I attached a simple spend view for three scenarios (low/likely/high) based on the proposed price — that shows effective $/1M in each case.

Next steps:
1) If that looks good, we’ll publish a short Order Form and DocuSign link by EOD Wed 9/9.
2) Please confirm who in Procurement will sign (procure@cloudforge.io ok?) and whether Legal needs to review the one-page addendum.

If you’d like the alternative pricing (flat $35 up to 30M then tier to $28), say the word and I’ll include both options in the OF for their legal/finance review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call with Procurement if that speeds things up.

Best,
